# Fixtures for rd_noplanes_ab (port/render/test/rd_noplanes_ab.cmake: the
# screen-prim triangles through the plain sprite builds,
# ICO_RD_NO_SPRITE_PLANES=1, against the run with the sprite planes builds;
# issue 161): fixture names of this repository
# (port/render/test/fixtures/NAME.rdfix), a name a line, then expect=same (no
# command through the fallback, every target byte for byte),
# expect=fallback:N (N commands through the fallback, every target byte for
# byte) or expect=report (commands through the fallback, the targets that
# differ listed), the line's own property (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake):
# noplanes_fallback, the commands through the plain builds, and then
# rd_replay_tool's setting arguments.
#
# the title (e2e run with the title on, frames 200 and 350) and the boot's
# frame 600: one screen-prim triangle key with planes each (program 9 vs 22
# fs 28: sprite_plane_world_vs + sprite_ps_planes, the key the Retroid Pocket
# 6's lazy run made in its title); 2 commands through the plain builds on the
# fixture as on its source
fx-title-0200 expect=fallback:2 noplanes_fallback=2
fx-title-0350 expect=fallback:2 noplanes_fallback=2
fx-boot-0600 expect=fallback:2 noplanes_fallback=2
# a frame with no screen-prim triangle with planes (a 2026-10-07 capture):
# the switch changes nothing
fx-vu-3112 expect=same noplanes_fallback=0 --aspect 4:3
